newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC tower to be ready in August.
newsitem.headline: CITIC tower to be ready in August.

text.p: CITIC Pacific Ltd said on Wednesday construction of its 33-storey Grade-A office complex CITIC Tower will be completed in August 1997.
"Completion of the building is now expected to be in August 1997, barely two years from when the land was first purchased in August 1995," chairman Larry Yung said.

"As the sovereignty of Hong Kong reverts on 30th June 1997, this significant investment of HK$5 billion shows the commitment of CITIC, and our partners, in the future of Hong Kong under one country, two systems," Yung said.

Hong Kong, British colony of over 150 years, reverts to China on July 1. It is promised under Sino-British handover treaties a high degree of autonomy under a "one country, two systems" formula for the next 50 years.

CITIC Tower, a multi-level shopping mall along the waterfront in Central district in Hong Kong, is 65 percent owned by CITIC Pacific and its parent China International Trust & Investment Corporation Hong Kong (Holdings) Ltd.
It is also 25 percent owned by Kerry Holdings Ltd and 10 percent by Development Bank of Singapore Ltd.
The developers have also reserved space to set up headquarter offices for CITIC Pacific and Kerry Holdings and a regional office for Development Bank of Singapore, CITIC said in a statement.
